purpose: Unpackaged source authority for Gorochu's connected-tail 64 px 2D battle sprites

final_64_pipeline.front: Exact wiki normal/shiny PNGs; native 2x grid decimated to the authored 80 px basis, then explicit hard-nearest centre sampling to 64 px. Full body and complete tail remain one fixed opaque component.
final_64_pipeline.back: Reviewed 5.4.0 edition back enlarged to 64 px with the same hard-nearest sampler and mapped into exact wiki fur/gold palette slots. The dark root, loop and yellow lightning blade remain connected and fixed.
final_64_pipeline.animation: Only detached yellow/white charge clusters change over six frames; no body or tail pixel moves.
final_64_pipeline.variants: Shiny uses the exact wiki shiny source/palette; classic is an exact 0/85/170/255 neutral transform. Variant alpha masks are identical frame-by-frame.
final_64_pipeline.forbidden: No bilinear filtering, antialiasing, halo colours, cyan or light-blue in the normal set.
